description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022: GreenWall Systems: less steel, more earth for equitable and sustainable hazard resilience is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Srikanth Madabhushi S C, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This poster discusses a novel type of coastal defense, termed a 'GreenWall'. The proposed research on GreenWalls is inspired by the Doctoral work of the PI on Dual Row Retaining Walls. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-29fx-ed12. Keywords: Coastal Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Retaining Walls, Earthquake, Tsunami, Centrifuge Testing. Published 2023-03-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
